title: Wardrobe Veto
summary: Johnny vetoes V's clothes in an arcade near Corpo Plaza and asks why V dresses the way V does.
description: Johnny has opinions about V's jacket. He wants V to try on three looks in a bright arcade near Corpo Plaza, and he judges every one.

start.bringUp: Johnny has opinions about your jacket. Bring up, in your own way and sharp, that V should go shopping in a bright arcade near Corpo Plaza and try on three looks for him to judge.

arcade.name: a bright arcade of clothing shops near Corpo Plaza

rack.name: a clothing rack in the arcade with one jacket on a hook

g1.asks: Why do you dress like that? I don't mean it's wrong. I mean what's it for?
g1.know: The gear read for each look, the Arasaka veto, and his love of sleeveless and leather.
g1.secret: He wore the same jacket for years because it was his only one.

stages.label: Try on three looks for Johnny
stages.objective: Try on three looks for Johnny in the Corpo Plaza arcade
stages.know: Johnny judges three looks V puts on: nothing with a corporate logo, something he would wear on stage, and the worst thing V owns. Any Arasaka item makes him furious.
stages.wants: V to try on the looks and answer Johnny's question about the clothes.

all.memory: You let Johnny judge your looks in an arcade near Corpo Plaza, and you defended the one you wear.

some.memory: You let Johnny judge a look or two in an arcade near Corpo Plaza, and he teased you about the rest.

variations.know: It is daytime and rain is falling. The three looks are rain gear.
The three looks are funeral outfits, and Johnny says it is a joke, which it is not.
Johnny asks V to dress as someone V is not, and judges each look against that.
